notes.title: Winter Event Farewell
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy, Barn Finders! 🚜[/h1]

The snow’s melting (well, at least in our imaginations), and that means one thing: it’s almost time to say goodbye to our annual Winter Event! We know, we know—it’s sad to see Devin’s galactic shenanigans go, but there’s still time to jump in and grab those exclusive rewards. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/6078dbc6a568b5acdc4630756b37d0fcad7a8514.gif[/img]

[u]Here’s what you need to know before we officially wrap things up for this year:[/u]

[h2]🎁 Last Chance to Claim Your Winter Event Rewards![/h2]
Before the Winter Event bids us farewell for another year, we want to make sure no Barn Finder gets left out in the cold. There are exclusive, seasonal goodies waiting for you to unlock:

[list]
[*] Seasonal Skins for your trusty tools. Who doesn’t want to wield a wrench with a frosty festive flair?
[*] Winter-Themed Wallpapers and Floors to transform your pawn shop into a winter wonderland.
[*] And the ultimate Mystery Reward, which Devin insists is “cooler than space moonshine” (and that’s saying something).
[/list]
But to claim all of this loot, you’ll need to finish the Devin map before the event closes. So what are you waiting for? Go help Devin protect his mansion, lay some traps, and teach those bumbling burglars a lesson they won’t forget!

[h2]💖 A Huge Thank You to Our Fans[/h2]
To everyone who jumped into the Winter Event this year—thank you from the bottom of our barn-shaped hearts! 🐔 Your enthusiasm, humor, and dedication warm us up better than any cup of space cocoa could. We hope you had as much fun as we did during these chilly days!

[u][b]2025 is a very special year for us at Barn Finders HQ because it marks our 5th Anniversary! 🎉 We couldn’t have made it this far without you, our amazing community. Whether you’re an OG barn scavenger or a newbie, we’re thrilled to have you along for this wild ride.[/b][/u]

And remember, the fun doesn’t stop here! If you’re itching for more Barn Finders goodness, don’t forget to check out our two awesome DLCs:

American Dream DLC 🇺🇸: More barns, more weird treasures, and, of course, more laughs.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1424060/Barn_Finders_Amerykan_Dream/
Bid Wars DLC 💸: Flex those auction skills and outbid your rivals for the rarest items!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554910/Barn_Finders_Bid_Wars_DLC/
Both DLCs are packed with the quirky charm you know and love. So if you haven’t explored them yet, now’s the perfect time!

🤝 Shoutout to Our Friends
Before we sign off, we want to give a special mention to our friends working on an incredible new game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

So, Barn Finders, let’s make the most of these final Winter Event days. Whether you’re defending Devin’s loot or sprucing up your pawn shop, we’re thrilled to have you as part of our community. Here’s to many more adventures, barns, and hilarious mishaps ahead!

[b]Stay weird,
The Barn Finders Team[/b]

notes.title: Barn Finders Winter Event
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, fellow Barn Finders! 🌟[/h1]
The long-awaited Winter Event has finally landed, and boy, do we have an adventure for you. Buckle up your space boots, grab your Upgrade Gun, and let’s dive into the cosmic madness of this year’s holiday escapade!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/79d3334d83dc22ac3a7aa016d42a6c9d282dfe1d.gif[/img]
[h2]A Brief History of the Alien Devin's Holiday Mishaps[/h2]
Every December, our beloved alien pal Devin finds himself in a galactic pickle. The story’s always the same: Devin gets into a massive pre-Christmas fight with his family, they jet off to the Moon, and Devin stays behind in their space mansion.
But what’s Christmas without a little chaos? Enter the usual suspects: a thieving duo—one crafty, the other, let’s just say... lacking in brain cells—attempting to rob Devin blind. Normally, Devin, a genius in a kid’s costume, would set traps to outwit these dim-witted burglars.
This year, however, things are different. Devin downed a whole bottle of his parents’ finest moonshine and—surprise, surprise—he’s in no shape to handle the situation. Desperate for help, he’s called in none other than Buttson. Together, with your help, it’s time to lay traps, protect the loot, and save Christmas! 🎄

[h2]What Awaits You in the Winter Event?[/h2]
Here’s what you’ll be doing in this wacky holiday showdown:
[h3]Trap Building Mayhem[/h3]
[list]
[*] 5 Trap Locations: Devin’s house has five prime spots where traps need to be set.
[*] Choose the Right Trap: Use your trusty Upgrade Gun to select the perfect trap for each location.
[*] Brain Teasers Galore: Not every trap works in every spot—choose carefully, or risk a burglar breakthrough!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/dd51cd89b8a812e99d1151e961a693894f273ce8.gif[/img]
[h3]Holiday Loot Galore![/h3]
This event is packed with rewards that will make your pawn shop the talk of the galaxy:
[list]
[*] Brand New Items to collect and sell.
[*] Festive Decorations to deck out your pawn shop in holiday style.
[*] Exclusive Skins for your tools and gadgets.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/a92248d5c06b7938e8901e33d6289b894dc8fd7e.gif[/img]
[b]And, of course, a mystery reward for completing the event that Devin swears is “worth more than moon rocks!”[/b]

[h2]Limited-Time Fun! Don’t Miss Out![/h2]
Remember, this event is cyclical—meaning it won’t return for a full year! If you’re itching to protect Devin’s house and claim those juicy rewards, now’s the time to dive in. Don’t wait until next year to see what all the buzz is about!

[h2]Thank You for an Amazing Year![/h2]
From the bottom of our intergalactic hearts, thank you for supporting Barn Finders throughout the year. Your love and enthusiasm keep us going!
We wish you all a [b]Merry Christmas[/b], a [b]Happy New Year[/b], and a holiday season filled with laughter, loot, and lots of traps! See you in-game!
[u][b]The Barn Finders Team 🛸[/b][/u]

In this short devlog, we’d like to show both new and seasoned players a key gameplay element of Barn Finders: transforming your finds into profit. This process is central to the experience, and it consists of several important stages, each of which plays a crucial role in the game.
[h2]Key Stages of Turning Finds into Profit[/h2]
[b]1. Finding the Items[/b]
The journey starts by discovering items across a variety of maps, often in the most unexpected places. You might stumble upon a treasure hidden in the depths of a pit or buried underground. Sometimes, reaching the coveted item requires solving simple puzzles to unlock secret areas, such as hidden caves brimming with valuable goods.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/187f115fcef55f88d49b7e9a523d6540a2ff1af2.gif[/img]
[b]2. Cleaning and Restoration[/b]
Once you’ve secured your find, it’s not always ready for sale. Many items need a bit of TLC before they’re shop-worthy. Some will simply need a good cleaning, while others might require full restoration. This is where you’ll need to gather the right materials and resources to repair and bring your treasures back to life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/3257f97c94faa2f4fb593008d861de9f66772f4d.gif[/img]
[b]3. Selling and Negotiating[/b]
After cleaning or restoring your finds, it’s time to put them up for sale in your beautiful pawn shop. But the work doesn’t end here—negotiating with potential buyers is crucial to securing the best profit. Be prepared to haggle and make deals that benefit both you and your customers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/ec030ea9969645a71e4569f88f1ec24c727ee142.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello, Barn Finders![/h1]

Today, we’re diving into one of the most exciting aspects of Barn Finders—the auction mechanic and the intriguing variety of storage units you can discover.

[h2]Auction Mechanics: How It Works[/h2]
In Barn Finders, auctions are where the real action begins. You’ll compete against other bidders to win abandoned storage units that could hold untold treasures... or just a bunch of junk! The thrill of the auction lies in the mystery—you can only see a portion of what’s inside before making your bid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/78c89cd1f145a92e6f5f4f9e6c8fa5dd9c58dfeb.gif[/img]

notes.title: M.I.K.K.O’s Diner Barn & Dualicious G: A Mystery Unfolds 🍔🎸
notes.notes:
Have you heard the story of the mysterious disappearance of the famous band, Dualicious G? Known for their hit song “Homage to Most Likely the Best Song in the Universe” and many more, this dynamic duo vanished without a trace after visiting M.I.K.K.O’s Diner Barn. Today, we delve into the enigma that has puzzled fans and investigators alike. 🕵️‍♂️🕵️‍♀️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/f8cd1add3d5555f6826a98f3bbfc10cc1c78bb87.png[/img]

Our story begins in 1976, during Dualicious G’s Camper Tour. The band was lured to M.I.K.K.O’s Diner Barn, famed for its Big M.I.K.K.O’s Burger—reputedly the most delicious piece of meat in all of America. 🍔 The promise of this legendary burger was too tempting to resist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/dd38ae651f9ec4a5324051fc60b3f04488592cfd.png[/img]

Upon arrival, the band retreated to their trailer for a quick refreshment and a taste of the famed burger. Shortly after, they headed to the parking lot for a rehearsal. This is where things took a dark turn. Diners reported hearing a loud explosion 💥 and a demonic laugh. 😈 Some claimed they heard guitar riffs 🎸, while others denied any such sounds. The accounts were conflicting, but one fact remains indisputable: from that moment on, neither member of Dualicious G nor the recipe for the Big M.I.K.K.O’s Burger was ever seen again. 🕳️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/8f8b46f7193f4afb990ec546402ab7d92a502c7b.png[/img]

With its flagship product gone, M.I.K.K.O’s Diner Barn swiftly went out of business. The property is now up for sale through M.I.K.K.O’s Property Services. Many have attempted to uncover the truth behind the band’s disappearance and the lost recipe, but all efforts have been in vain. ❓🏚️

That’s all in today's episodes of Mystery Unfolds. If you want to learn more about Dualicious G and many other mysteries in the Barn Finders and its DLC’s - get it today with a whopping 45% discount! In the next episode: BigFoot in Summer Camp. 

Oh, and by the way, if you’re a fan of a good burger, check out our upcoming game, Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator. 🎮🍟 It features plenty of great recipes, and who knows—perhaps the legendary Big M.I.K.K.O’s Burger will make an appearance. Stay tuned! 🍔👀

While not as close in proximity, Distant Cousin Billy shares the same bloodline with our farming hero. The main protagonists in both games are cousins, and their uncles, though different in character and expertise, share the same roots. It's a testament to the diversity within a family, where one member tends the land, and another hunts for lost artifacts.

The spirit of adventure and hard work runs deep in this family. Whether you're planting crops in the vast fields of Farm Simulator or embarking on treasure hunts in the cluttered barns of Barn Finders, the essence remains the same. We would like to introduce you to the newest update to the Barn Finders, which except many bug fixes contains also two new mechanics - Chicken Sonar and Clients selling items. 

[h2]Chicken Sonar[/h2]

If you ever had a problem with finding the last one item on the map (who the hell hid them there, right?) - this is a tool for you. Just press and hold button and then release, and the Sonar will inform you if there is any item in your area. As simple as that. You still have to look for it, but it sure makes it a lot easier. Right outside your pawnshop we put a small little stand. From now on, from time to time, some of the Clients will go there and offer you an item they want to get rid of. notes.title: #Devlog 4
notes.notes:
Howdy Players!

What a month friends! You can probably tell from our different posts that we are blown away by your reactions and feedback we receive. From the whole Barn Finders team - we thank you. You’ve made those difficult times a little bit more bearable. Reading your feedback and watching your playthroughs: always a bright point in our day! We hope you are all safe and healthy. We just want to let you know that we have been working from home since this whole Coronavirus situation started. We are pushing towards the full release as hard as we can.

So, you are probably wondering what’s next after the end of our Kickstarter campaign. Here are some updates:

- We are preparing the wallpapers and other not in-game rewards, so we can send them to you as soon as possible. Who wouldn’t want to have Uncle Billy on his wallpaper, right?

- We have been watching your playthroughs and gathering the feedback sent to us, tweaking and improving the game as possible. Improvements such as: Changes in the Client system, controls bindings, widescreen support, shop mechanics & upgrades updates, interactable characters on the map and more. 

- We are polishing the current game maps, besides adding the new ones from Kickstarter. Putting all together, we now have 12 maps, full of collectibles, new places to explore and more wacky stuff.

- We are adding new assembly items. 

- We are also adding new types of collectible items. Which you can find during your adventures through Ameryka.

We are still discussing what to do with the remaining stretch goals. If we decide something, we will let you know. Maybe you can tell us which one you would like to see in the game? (Chicken Sonar, Profile Customization, Bid Wars…) - Btw, there is a cool Bid Wars trailer here: https://bit.ly/3495ZZS

That is it friends. Once again, we thank you for all the support, kind words and love for our game. 

Stay safe and well. Talk to you soon!

Michał Szewerniak
Game Director @ Duality Games

notes.title: THE BIG ANNOUNCEMENT - BARN FINDERS KICKSTARTER
notes.notes:
Howdy!

It took us some time, but we are finally here. The day has come, and we would like to share with you what we’ve been working on for quite some time - we are launching a kickstarter campaign for the Barn Finders!  Don’t be shy, you can find the link just right here:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/barn-finders]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playway/barn-finders[/url]

But wait, there is more!

Just for our backers, we prepared the early access to the demo version, so you can check for yourself what we prepared, and tell us what you think. The lowest pledge is just 9 CA$, so don’t miss it out! We can't wait for You to play it.

We are also hosting a dev stream right now (starting around 16:00 CET), if you want to talk to us, or watch us play the game, join us!

[previewyoutube=-CwpoxejXZU;full][/previewyoutube]

WHAT’S OUR GOAL?

For us, the campaign has multiple purposes. Here are some of them:

Funding the campaign will allow us to add 2 more maps to the game, which we’ve cut out of the scope for production reasons. So, from a total of 10 maps to visit we will increase the number to 12. And trust us, both Auntie Mary’s House and The Evil Swamp are super cool maps with some unique twists - you will love them. 

We want to gather your feedback. For us it’s very important that Barn Finders meets your expectations and represents the best quality possible. To do that, we want your input about our game. Use the “SEND FEEDBACK” option in the game, to share thoughts, feedback, bugs or just something you liked. We promise to read all of it and we will try to address the issues if possible.

We want to share some Barn Finders love with the world. Tell your friends about the game if you liked it. Tell your parents, that lady in the grocery shop and the bus driver. Don’t tell Carlos. He already knows. Add the game to your wishlist, like us on Facebook, talk to us on Discord. 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34344567/52bc993d34924f0188da1dd948657447e23a5d39.jpg[/img]

Stretch Goals. Over the production time, we had to cut a lot of cool ideas from the main game scope, so we could do everything on time. But we want to revisit those ideas and try to implement them by our stretch goals. For example, MIKKO’s Item Catalog, Clients selling items, a fully M.I.K.K.O’s Bid Wars Event Map, etc. We will talk about them with more details, soon. 

So. This is it. Our adventure can finally begin. We hope you will enjoy Barn Finders as much as we do. Share with us what you think.

Cheers!  

Duality Team

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Hey friends, we are still preparing the ground for our “Big Announcement” (having some dates, yeah!), so keep an eye for future updates. 
 
How about talking about some game mechanics?
 
[u]The Storage Station[/u]
 
Today we are going to talk about the amazing Storage Station, developed by M.I.K.K.O. tech experts.
Every player will have one Storage Station placed in their Pawnshop. This is the spot where you can drop and store collected stuff from the game maps. 
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34344567/9e95f556e84aacb7bcd7b6affab7b8d54d0aaccd.jpg[/img]

[u]Using The Storage Station [/u]
 
After arriving from an adventure, you will be able to take the stuff from the Barn Finders Truck to the Storage Station. But don't worry, if you are feeling too lazy to take the  items one by one, you can call Uncle Billy for help.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34344567/0b82dda520d90d7991e5e263d2e5715dbfe52b52.jpg[/img]
 
After unloading the truck,players can check the status of each previous collected stuff by opening the Storage Station Menu. A list of all previous collected items will be shown. It should look like this:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34344567/5440c85f3d24f52fecb377a36559e52752ca0ad6.png[/img]

[u]What the heck are these icons?[/u]
 
Starting from left to right:
 
[u]The “Stars Icon”[/u]
Here we have an example of a [u]Job Quest Item[/u]: Butch, The Champion. The “Stars” means that this item cannot be sold to Pawnshop customers, because this Item already has a buyer. Usually, someone will write you an email, giving you the location to where this item can be found in Ameryka. So, Players must travel there, look for this specific item and bring it back to Barn Finders pawnshop. Then, Player will be able to pack and send the item, completing the Quest, winning some bucks.
 
[u]The “Puzzle Icon”[/u]
The “puzzle icon” means that this item actually is a [u]part of a set[/u]. For example here, the HellStorm Flamethrower Tanks. Which means that Player must find and assemble all item parts first, before selling it to clients. For that, Players must buy and build an Assembly Station to their Pawnshop.
 [u]
The “Flies Icon”[/u]
Oh-Oh, something is [u]Dirty[/u]. Clients don't like that and they are not going to buy any smelly and dirty treasures. For example, here we have a model of Shirley Love, which was found in Red Barn, a.k.a. Dwayne’s Love Nest. This item requires cleaning before selling it. Players can buy a Cleaning Station to wash and turn Dirty items to “Ready to Sell.”
 
[u]No Icons![/u]
No icons means that the item is [u]Ready to Sell[/u]. For example here we have the crossbow The Honor, which is ready to be placed on a shelf, while waiting for a new lovely home.
 
 
[u]The "Hammer Icon”[/u]
A “hammer icon” informs the Player that this item is currently [u]Broken[/u] and cannot be sold before fixed. Then, Player must repair this item by spending resources such as Metal, Wood or Scraps. For that, they will need to buy and improve their Pawnshop by having a Repair Station.

[u]Using the Storage Station to Place Items on Shelves[/u]
 
If some stuff is inside the Storage Station, Player can quickly place them on the Pawnshop shelves by one click. Easy right? But remember, it is only possible to do that with “Ready to Sell” items. 
 
So that’s it for now. In a few days we are going to speak more about other mechanics and what you will be able to find inside the wacky universe of Barn Finders. 
 
Thanks a lot for the attention guys, see you soon for more updates!
 
Gabriel Rutherford
Game Designer @ Duality Games

notes.title: BF DEVLOG #1
notes.notes:
Howdy Players!

First of all, before we start this devlog let us apologize for not talking with you that much these past months, but we were very busy with Barn Finders. But we also make a promise that this will change now. So if you have any questions hit us up, it can be here on steam or Facebook or our Discord (all the links are at the end of this post). You can expect also more of devlogs, introducing you to our game. So, fingers crossed, there is an exciting time ahead of us!

Now, let’s talk a bit about Barn Finders. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34344567/ae6b900e2c340246664cdf9ad24534390fb4b160.jpg[/img]

In the early 90’s, deep into the land of Ameryka (largely similar to real America, but not quite) there is a small company called Barn Finders Ltd. It’s only employee and CEO is Uncle Billy (some suspect “Uncle” is his real name, as no one calls him differently). His CV includes: sleeping, drinking cheap booze, making bad decisions and being rather crazy. So, as you can imagine, the Barn Finders was not in the greatest shape. Shelves in the pawnshop were empty, and the only customers were spiders and dust devils. All the competition was laughing at him, and even M.I.K.K.O company stopped sending him offers (and let’s be honest, they send it to everyone, right?).

Everything will change when You will arrive.

Help Uncle Billy build up his company from the ground and bring back a good name to Barn Finders Ltd. Some people are looking for certain items, so you can look for them in abandoned or auctioned properties. While you do that, while not take the rest of the valuable stuff and sell it in your pawnshop for profit? Some of them needs to be cleaned, some of them needs to be repaired, and some of them needs to be built from parts. 
    
And the Clients? They all have their preferences and sometimes you will need to haggle to make sure you will get a good price for your stuff. Oh, Uncle Billy said something about a thief, but I’m pretty sure he was lying. Other day he said he saw a UFO, so you can see he lost his mind. 

Did he?

Yes, he did. 

Join Uncle Billy on his journey through Ameryka, and help him save Barn Finders Ltd. 

This will be a hell of a ride!

Michał Szewerniak
Game Director @ Duality Games
